self_inflicted_narrow_market_price_crash.description: Variant D redirects 100% of MELON's freed portfolio share into the single highest-ranked substitute crop (STRAWBERRY, per economic_model.crop_production_value()), with no awareness of that crop's market depth (T parameter). STRAWBERRY has the smallest market depth (T=100) of any of the 5 crops (WHEAT=400, CARROT=450, TOMATO=200, MELON=300), so concentrating an entire freed farm's production into it crashes its own price -- NOT an opponent-driven effect (expansion_oriented never grows STRAWBERRY).
